create_classification_model: create a ClassificationModel instance from a pretrained sequence classification model path with device and dtype
predict_scores: predict classification scores for a padded batch of input tokens using the ClassificationModel
check_model_parameters: check if a classification model supports position_ids or token_type_ids via forward signature inspection
get_max_input_length: get the maximum input length for a classification model based on config and model type
review_classification_model: review the ClassificationModel class to understand how it loads models and handles batch prediction
